# Ruster's transform-gizmo compatibility trial

Updated2026-11-04. Vendored published `transform-gizmo`0.11.0 with its source unchanged and normalized ecolor/emath/epaint dependency constraints raised0.36→0.37. Companion `../transform-gizmo-egui`0.11.0 raises egui/dev-eframe constraints to0.37, renames `Ui::id` to `Ui::scope_id`, and resolves this core by sibling path. `RUSTER-COMPATIBILITY.patch` captures the six upstream-line changes with zero context (`git apply --unidiff-zero`); the sibling path is a Ruster packaging addition. The published README is preserved as README.upstream with a local README wrapper because archive-relative media/contributor targets are absent. Package-local lockfiles/registry bookkeeping and unused example sources are omitted; workspace lock owns resolution.

Origin commit `07a951ec17ebff2de4608b711ee0544ff2c8063c`, published archive hashes, exact-commit MIT/Apache license sources/hashes and trial dependency additions are in `RUSTER-PROVENANCE.json`. Upstream source comments/attributions are retained. Both packages are MIT OR Apache-2.0; downloaded package archives omitted readable license files, so exact-commit originals were added to both vendored directories. This code is third-party software, not original Ruster implementation.

The narrow patch avoids duplicating the egui0.36 paint/math/color/font family while integrating with the existing0.37 editor. Glam0.32 remains additional to renderer0.30; no measured executable/memory or compile-time advantage is implied. No unsafe-code waiver is added. This is a bounded editor integration candidate; native and workflow acceptance remain required. The source/gesture assessment and trial failures/corrections are in `docs/MANIPULATION.md` and `docs/evidence/M8-gizmo-trial.md` from the repository root.

Revisit/removal trigger: upstream compatible release, GUI dependency upgrade, changed geometry conventions or failed interaction evidence. Compare against upstream source and retain license/provenance checks when updating. Do not replace the root HAL patch or weaken Vulkan validation.
